description: A laptop on a desk shows lines of green code in a dark editor. A young man in a hoodie clenches his fist and cheers at his screen. He then sits at a two-monitor desk in an open office, typing code with both hands. In a dark room a whole team stands in front of a wall of monitors filled with code. When a huge green check mark appears on the central screen, the whole team throws their arms up and cheers.
transcript: Aha! Got it! Nice! Almost there... It works!

taps.phrase: to point at the laptop screen
taps.target: the woman in the denim shirt

taps.phrase: to appear on the main screen
